title: Payment webhook lookup by provider reference: the query is right, the index is missing
prompt: Payment-provider webhook handler: about 0.5 calls per second on average, bursts of 5 per second after settlement
runs. Each call: about 1.4 s elapsed, 6 s CPU at DOP 8, and 1.1M logical reads. Plan: parallel Clustered Index Scan
of PK_Payments (60M rows) with predicate ExternalRef = @ExternalRef; it returns 0 to 2 rows. The parameter is
nvarchar(64), the same type as the column. CPU is pinned during bursts. The table takes about 180 inserts per second
data_notes: Azure SQL Database, General Purpose Gen5, 8 vCores, compatibility level 160. READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT ON. Query Store READ_WRITE. Collation SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS. All foreign keys are trusted. Statistics: auto create and auto update ON; a nightly job updates Orders, OrderLines and Payments with FULLSCAN.

Payments: 60M rows. Status: Settled 88%, Failed 6%, Refunded 4% (negative Amount), Pending 2%. ExternalRef is NULL for ~30%; non-NULL values are almost unique, with a few duplicates from provider retries. Partner accounts have up to 180k Settled or Refunded payments each. Settlement batches stamp the same PaidAt on 50-500 payments.

traps.why: There is no implicit conversion to fix: the types already match. A cast to varchar loses characters outside the code page and can match the wrong reference.
traps.told_apart_by: A provider reference that contains a character outside code page 1252.

traps.why: RECOMPILE or MAXDOP 1 lowers the parallel CPU, but each call still reads 1.1M pages.
Provider retries create duplicate references. A unique build fails, or later inserts fail.
An offline build blocks a table that takes 180 inserts per second.

min_improvement.basis: 1.1M logical reads per call become a seek of 3 or 4 reads.

key.reference_notes: Build the index ONLINE and RESUMABLE. Use the filtered form only after the plan of the parameterized statement is seen to choose it.
